scripts.script:
The surviving warriors cross the boundary as the labyrinth shifts behind them.

Passages fold closed. Walls grind together, swallowing the route you used only moments before.

Enough of the team made it through.

The tomb tried to seal you inside.

It failed.

Mission accomplished.

The last routes begin to close.

One passage after another vanishes behind walls of living metal until the labyrinth becomes silent once more.

Too few escaped before the tomb completed its transformation.

The survivors are scattered.

The mission is lost.

Another sealed access point gives way.

Across the crypt, forced hatchways and shattered breach points now form a path through defenses never meant to be opened from within.

The tomb can no longer contain the route.

The way forward is open.

Mission accomplished.

The sealed network holds.

The openings you forced are not enough. Beyond them, ancient barriers remain intact as the tomb begins securing the damaged passages.

The route was never fully broken.

The way forward remains closed.

Mission failed.

The carrier crosses the boundary with the transponder still in hand.

Behind them, the signal fades beneath layers of stone and living metal, but this time it is leaving the crypt with you.

The device is secure.

Extraction successful.

Mission accomplished.

The signal fades.

Whether buried somewhere within the crypt or lost with those who tried to recover it, the transponder remains beyond reach.

Static fills the channel.

Then nothing.

Whatever information it carried will remain inside the Tomb World.

Mission failed.

The final breach tears through the sarcophagus.

Living metal splits beneath cascading emerald energy as the stasis systems collapse. Across the chamber, ancient mechanisms flicker and die.

Whatever was meant to awaken here will remain entombed.

Mission accomplished.

The sarcophagus endures.

Fractures begin to close as living metal flows back across its surface. One by one, damaged systems stabilize and the chamber falls into an unnatural calm.

The opportunity is gone.

The tomb has preserved what sleeps within.

Another chamber falls silent.

Enough of the sub-crypt has now been opened, cleared and mapped to reveal the shape of what lies beneath the Tomb World.

The darkness still holds many secrets.

But not these.

The reconnaissance is complete.

Mission accomplished.

The exploration ends here.

Beyond the chambers you reached, sealed rooms continue into the darkness, their contents unknown and their guardians undisturbed.

Too much of the sub-crypt remains hidden.

The tomb keeps its secrets.

Mission failed.

One by one, the survivors emerge from the tomb's phasing routes.

Scattered warriors become a formation again, gathering together beyond the maze of impossible passages.

The tomb divided you.

It could not keep you apart.

The team is reunited.

Mission accomplished.

The phasing routes never bring the team back together.

Warriors remain separated by chambers, sealed passages and distances that refuse to behave as they should.

The tomb has divided the survivors and denied them any chance to reform.

The regroup has failed.
